'WO Board and Tech View – questions for Chris Ward (14 Oct 2026)

'Hi Chris, while checking the WO Board and Tech View test cases against the spec (version 48) and the design shared on 14 Oct, we found a few points only you can decide. Please write your answer in the yellow column; a letter such as (a) or (b) is enough.

'Since 12 Oct the spec says a shift counts as a whole-work-order shift when it "covers every current line".
(a) A work order with only one line: does a shift on that line count as a whole-work-order shift?
(b) A shift made with Choose lines that ticks every line: does it count?
(c) Do lines that are not approved, or are declined, count as "current lines"?
(d) If a line is added after an Entire work order shift was made, does that shift still count?
'On the Schedule a one-line work order is booked at once as a whole. Four test cases depend on (a).

'A pinned technician who is no longer at this location but still leads work here now appears as a normal, unpinned column holding that work.
(a) Can work be dropped onto that column?
(b) Does it show the inactive marker?
(c) What does it show once it is empty?
'On 24 Sep Sasha said to treat such technicians like inactive ones. On 7 Oct a developer said a drop there is refused with "This technician can't be assigned work orders."

'(a) Should a card's estimated hours leave out declined lines?
(b) May the figure differ from the work order page by 0.1 hours?
'Only a developer has said so (12 Oct). The spec says estimated hours keep their existing meaning, and one test case expects the card to show the same figure as the List.

'Should cards and column headers show the person's account name while the List shows the staff record name?
(a) Yes, they may differ.
(b) No, they should match the List.
'Only a developer has said so (Slack, 12 Oct). One test case expects the card to match the List.

'The Review Decisions page (29 Sep) still lists some points as open or with older answers (for example the Imported lock and the empty-state words).
(a) Will it be refreshed?
(b) Or should we treat the main spec as replacing it?
'The main spec has moved on since 29 Sep (versions 43 to 48).

'The release notes say the lead technician "can't change on Invoiced, Paid or Imported work orders". Since 12 Oct Imported work orders open only in List, and the rule names Invoiced and Paid only. Should the release notes be updated?
'Imported ticked from a link or saved filter

'If a link or a saved filter opens Board View or Tech View with "Imported" already ticked, what should happen?
(a) The page opens in List instead.
(b) The view opens and Imported is unticked.
(c) Something else (please write it).
'The spec covers ticking Imported in List and the greyed option inside the views, but not this route.
'The spec's status line still reads "PRD v33" and its Change Log table is empty, although the page is at version 48. Could they be brought up to date, so everyone can see what changed and when?
'We dated every change from the page history instead.
'Work order preview panel in the List (new in the design)

'The design shared on 14 Oct adds a "Work order preview" panel: clicking a List row opens the work order in a side panel (with Open Work Order and a close X), instead of opening the work order page. The spec says: "List remains the default and is unchanged from production; the only addition to the Work Orders page is the display switcher."
(a) The panel is part of this release (the spec needs a new section).
(b) The panel is a later idea; for now a List row opens the work order as today.

'Only List rows open it in the design; Tech View rows and Board cards do not. While open, it covers the display switcher and the New Work Order button. Several test cases expect a List row click to open the work order page.

'Since 8 Oct the spec gives exact "no results" messages for Tech View and Board View ("No work orders match these filters" with a Clear all filters button, or "No work orders match the search …" for a search alone). The design still shows its older "No results for …" messages, with no Clear all filters button. It also still shows Imported work orders in Tech View and Board View, which the spec removed on 12 Oct.
(a) The spec is right; the design will be updated (please let Branko know).
(b) The design is right; the spec will change.
'Test cases follow the spec. We list this so the build and the design do not drift apart.

'The design has "Collapse all" / "Expand all" for the technician groups, and a Columns menu with "Find a column", "Show all" and "Reset to default". The developers said on 8 Oct these are not in this release, and their test cases have since been removed. Can you confirm they are not part of release 26.43.0?
(a) Confirmed, not in this release.
(b) They are in this release.
